terms.description: Terms of Service accepted. Must be true.

privacy.description: Privacy Policy accepted. Must be true.

password.description: At least 8 characters including a number.

deviceName.description: Shown in Settings > Security > Active sessions.

refreshToken.description: Opaque refresh token from the last sign-in or refresh.

identifier.description: Email address or phone number (Kenyan local formats are accepted).

id.description: Session family id; stable across refresh rotations.

recoveryCodes.description: Shown once, on first TOTP enrolment.

code.description: Authenticator code. Omit when using a recovery code.

entitlements.description: Hints for showing or hiding controls. The server decides every action.

permissions.description: Effective permissions, for the console sidebar.

reason.description: Why the account is being suspended. Kept in the audit log.

actorName.description: Name of the actor, when known.

uploadUrl.description: Signed URL. PUT the file bytes here with the headers below.

mimeType.description: Must be an allowed type for the kind.

sizeBytes.description: Exact size in bytes. The upload URL only accepts this length.

visibility.description: PUBLIC for files shown on public profiles; PRIVATE otherwise.

url.description: Short-lived signed download URL. Present only when the file is READY.

variants.description: Image renditions by width (200, 600, 1200) as signed URLs.

preferences.description: One entry per category. Categories never changed are on.

googleSignIn.description: Show "Continue with Google" only when true.

isDraft.description: True until the owner publishes reviewed text. Show it as a draft.

avatarUrl.description: Signed avatar URL (600 px), when a photo is set.

next.description: The most valuable missing items, heaviest first.

step.description: The step to show next (the resume point).

completed.description: True once the member finished onboarding and holds a Passport.

skipped.description: Skip this step: nothing is saved, the member moves on.

specialisationIds.description: SPECIALISATION. Must belong to the chosen discipline.

countyId.description: LOCATION. Must belong to the country.

locationVisibility.description: LOCATION. Who can see the county.

handle.description: BASICS. Lower-case letters, digits and underscores, 3 to 30 characters.

bio.description: BASICS. Short bio, up to 160 characters.

mediaId.description: A READY image the member uploaded through /media (PUBLIC).

suggestions.description: Free alternatives when the handle is taken or reserved.

usage.description: How many members currently use it.

icon.description: Disciplines only: a Lucide icon name.

disciplineId.description: Required for specialisations; optional for skills (blank = general).

ids.description: Ids in the new order. Applies within the same list (discipline) only.

isActive.description: false archives the entry (hidden from new selections, kept on existing profiles).

name.description: Publish it under a corrected name.

specialisationId.description: The existing specialisation this suggestion duplicates.

pendingRequests.description: Requests waiting for the member to answer.

headline.description: Send an empty string to clear it.

bio.description: Send an empty string to clear it.

contactShowEmail.description: Show the email when the contact section is visible.

contactShowPhone.description: Show the phone number when the contact section is visible.

contactForConnections.description: Accepted connections see contact details even when the section is private.

acceptConnections.description: When false nobody can send a connection request.

trust.description: Trust pills. Empty until real verification exists.

canConnect.description: Whether a request can be sent right now.

reason.description: Why a request cannot be sent.

relation.description: How the caller relates to this profile (or the preview they asked for).

connection.description: Null for the owner, in a preview and when signed out.

portfolioCount.description: Projects this viewer can open. Null while the Portfolio section is hidden from them.

serviceCount.description: Null while the Services section is hidden from this viewer.

visibleSections.description: Sections the caller may see (some have no content yet).

hidden.description: Hidden by a moderator. Only the owner ever sees a hidden project.

embedUrl.description: Set for YouTube and Vimeo links: the address of the embedded player.

name.description: A member’s display name, or the name typed in.

handle.description: Set when the collaborator is a member, so the app can open their profile.

hidden.description: Hidden by a moderator. Only the owner ever sees a hidden project.

hiddenReason.description: Owner only: why a moderator hid the project.

title.description: A draft may have no title yet.

role.description: Your role on the project. Empty clears it.

projectDate.description: A calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD. Empty clears it.

mediaIds.description: Your uploaded files in display order; the first is the cover. Replaces the list. At most 10.

skillIds.description: Skills used. Replaces the list. At most 10.

links.description: External links. Replaces the list. At most 5.

userId.description: An Atarah member. They must accept.

name.description: Someone who is not on Atarah.

projectCount.description: Published projects of yours that use this skill.

endDate.description: A calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD. Leave out while you still work there.

current.description: You still work there. Cannot be combined with an end date.

url.description: An https link to proof or coverage.

priceMin.description: Whole Kenya shillings. FIXED and RANGE only.

priceMax.description: Whole Kenya shillings. RANGE only, at least the minimum.

hidden.description: Hidden by a moderator. Only the owner ever sees a hidden project.
Hidden by a moderator. Only the owner ever sees a hidden project.

hiddenReason.description: Owner only: why a moderator hid the project.

saved.description: Whether the signed-in viewer saved it. False when signed out.

scheduled.description: Published with a time that has not come yet.
Published with a time that has not come yet.

text.description: The words of a paragraph, heading, callout or quote.

title.description: Callout heading, such as "Rule of thumb".

mediaId.description: An image block: a PUBLIC image you uploaded.

attribution.description: Who said it, for a quote.

sourceLabel.description: Who it came from. Empty clears it.

heroMediaId.description: A PUBLIC image you uploaded. Send an empty string to remove it.

publishAt.description: Go live at this time. Leave out to publish now.

type.description: More kinds join as opportunities and Skill Labs arrive.

reason.description: Why it is suggested, e.g. "Because you selected Animation".

tags.description: Up to three skills, only when the member shows them.

location.description: County, only when the member shows it to you.

article.description: The pinned article, else the newest.

unavailable.description: Sections that could not be loaded this time. The client hides them.

count.description: How many results there are in all.

groups.description: One group per kind that exists today. A kind with no results has a count of zero.
